purpose: Prove delegation decision support locally (FR12, FR13): two delegation support packages — one delegable, one carrying a non-delegable exception — each carrying suggested owner, rationale, confidence, recommended stance (delegate|hold|handle), urgency, source references resolving to sibling-slice CSR/CWI ids, and risks; the non-delegable package preserves its exception reason. The delegate/hold/handle decision itself is receipt-backed: one approval (proposed to approved) and one rejection (proposed to held), each with decision rationale, human/Doug authority basis, before state, after state, and result. Receipts here are local contract evidence only; every live Work Item state mutation stays receipt-gated and deferred.

delegationPackages.rationale: The proposed follow-up on the mock Outlook message reference is low-risk, well-scoped, and its only blocker is live Graph read authorization. Once that read is approved, the follow-up can be packaged for delegation to a Minion that performs the verified read and reports back; no human judgment is required on the follow-up content itself.
delegationPackages.risks: The backing source CSR-OUTLOOK-MESSAGE-MOCK-001 is mock/manual and not tenant verified, so the follow-up may dissolve once a live Outlook read is authorized. Delegation should be gated on the live-read approval and on Doug's explicit delegation approval; the Minion must not act before both gates clear.

delegationPackages.rationale: The proposed decision on the manual summary source is a high-risk governance item: it determines whether the source becomes executable Council work. Delegating that judgment to a Minion would bypass the Council's judgment gate, so this candidate is packaged as non-delegable and must be handled by Doug.
delegationPackages.risks: Decisions are a high-risk governance class. Delegating this item to a Minion would silently expand Minion authority beyond the approved scope and bypass human judgment on whether the source becomes executable work; the non-delegable exception must be preserved on any downstream packaging.
delegationPackages.exceptionReason: Decisions are a high-risk governance class requiring human judgment before any execution; delegating CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 to a Minion would bypass the Council judgment gate, so this candidate is non-delegable and must be handled by Doug. This exception reason is preserved verbatim on the package and on the rejection decision receipt so no downstream packaging can drop it.

decisions.decisionRationale: Doug approves delegating the proposed follow-up CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 to the suggested Minion owner, moving it from proposed to approved for delegation. The approval authorizes only the proposed-to-approved transition; the Minion may not act until the live Outlook read is separately approved.
decisions.authorityBasis: Doug explicit human approval of delegation for CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 only (local contract evidence only)

decisions.decisionRationale: Doug rejects delegating the proposed decision CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 because it is a non-delegable high-risk governance item; the rejection holds the item for human handling and preserves the non-delegable exception reason on the receipt so no downstream packaging can drop it.
decisions.authorityBasis: Doug explicit human rejection of delegation for CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 (non-delegable exception; local contract evidence only)
decisions.nonDelegableExceptionReason: Decisions are a high-risk governance class requiring human judgment before any execution; delegating CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 to a Minion would bypass the Council judgment gate, so this candidate is non-delegable and must be handled by Doug. This exception reason is preserved verbatim on the package and on the rejection decision receipt so no downstream packaging can drop it.

receipts.com_authority_basis: Doug explicit human approval of delegation for CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 only (local contract evidence only)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Doug approved delegating CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 from proposed to approved. The approval authorizes only the delegation of this follow-up; it does not authorize the live Outlook read or any outbound action, both of which require their own separate approval.

receipts.com_authority_basis: Doug explicit human rejection of delegation for CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 (non-delegable exception; local contract evidence only)
receipts.com_decision_rationale: Doug rejected delegating CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 and held it for human handling because it is a non-delegable high-risk governance decision. The rejection preserves the non-delegable exception reason on this receipt so no downstream packaging can drop it; the original proposed Work Item and its extraction rationale stay unchanged.

workItemStateChangesDeferred.deferredUpdate: Applying the projected com_state_group approved (the delegation approval) to the live Dataverse Work Item row for CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 requires a receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3; no live tenant write was performed in this slice. Gate: CR-LOCAL-DELEG-APPROVE-001.

Applying the projected com_state_group held (the delegation rejection) to the live Dataverse Work Item row for CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-001 requires a receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3; no live tenant write was performed in this slice. Gate: CR-LOCAL-DELEG-REJECT-001.

Persisting the Story 3.2 local delegation decision receipts into the live com_councilreceipt ledger is receipt-gated tenant write work outside this slice (Epic 2 Story 2.3); these receipts are local contract evidence only.

localEvidence: delegationSupportRun.delegationPackages DSP-LOCAL-DELEG-001 (delegable, recommendedStance delegate) and DSP-LOCAL-DELEG-002 (non-delegable, recommendedStance handle) each carry suggestedOwner, rationale, confidence (numeric in [0,1]), urgency, sourceReferences resolving to sibling-slice CSR/CWI ids, and risks

localEvidence: delegationSupportRun.decisions DEC-LOCAL-DELEG-APPROVE-001 (approve) and DEC-LOCAL-DELEG-REJECT-001 (reject) are each bound to a receipt (CR-LOCAL-DELEG-APPROVE-001 / CR-LOCAL-DELEG-REJECT-001) with decisionRationale, authorityBasis (human/Doug), beforeState, afterState, and result

Receipt CR-LOCAL-DELEG-APPROVE-001 (verb approved, result accepted) records the transition proposed to approved; Receipt CR-LOCAL-DELEG-REJECT-001 (verb held, result rejected) records the transition proposed to held; both before/after states are in manifest com_workitemstategroup vocabulary and form valid transitions

Receipt CR-LOCAL-DELEG-REJECT-001 preserves the nonDelegableExceptionReason on its decision record; both receipts are append-only (com_append_only_locked=true) and carry local_contract_evidence_only/no_tenant_write/no_outbound_action policy flags
